controls.label: Security headers
controls.detail: Cloudflare Worker applies CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, referrer policy, and related browser hardening.

controls.label: CSP discipline
controls.detail: Static CSP audit and hash propagation are part of build verification.

controls.label: RUM privacy
controls.detail: RUM is route-level and privacy-minimized; no user IDs, query strings, or free text are stored.

controls.label: Supply-chain scan
controls.detail: CANON-023 supply-chain verification runs in build:check.

controls.label: Obelisk adoption
controls.detail: Identity wrapper exists; passkey-first migration waits on Obelisk Phase 2.

controls.label: Responsible disclosure
controls.detail: Reports route to founder@vaultsparkstudios.com with the security.txt policy.
